name: Howard Park Public House
lede: In a South Bend city park, a year-round bar and restaurant sits beside the skating rink. Tungsten gas heaters around the building warm the patio and the skate-rental area through the colder months.
data: Park restaurant patio and skate-rental area

photos.caption: Photo: Gunn & Pegelow, via gunnpegelow.com. Permission to publish to be confirmed.

beats: Howard Park is a city park with a year-round bar and restaurant beside its ice rink, and a shop where skaters rent their skates.
Skaters and diners had to stay comfortable outside through the colder months of a snow-belt city.
Bromic Tungsten gas heaters are set around the perimeter of the building, warming the restaurant patio and the skate-rental area. The project was completed in winter 2020.
